turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on past questions with did?
turns.tutor:
We will get to did questions soon. First, a reminder: this lesson is about things that are finished, like yesterday.
Let me show you step by step. Every day I walk to the park. Yesterday is finished, so I take walk and add -ed: I walked to the park yesterday.
The rule: for most verbs, add -ed for a finished action.
Right: We opened the window yesterday. Wrong: We open the window yesterday.
Your turn. Write the past of "clean":
Yesterday Tom ___ his room.
